title: VDS LULLABY (92)
style: downtempo ambient lullaby, 92 BPM, instrumental with chipmunk-pitched vocal chops only (no lead vocal, no rap), warm Rhodes piano, soft analog pads, deep sub bass, brushed snare, vinyl crackle texture, tape saturation, gentle felt-piano motif, slow swelling strings, no drums until 1:00 then soft kick, dreamy reverb tail, comedown after the rave, hopeful resolution, 2026 production, no profanity, no real-artist references
lyrics:
[Intro — 0:00 — vinyl crackle, felt piano, soft pad swell, no drums]
(chop, soft, +5) "Keel — at — rest"
(chop, soft, +5) "Work — is — done"
(chop, soft) "Seven — hours — home"
(chop, soft) "VDS — sleeps"

[Verse — 0:32 — Rhodes piano, sub bass, brushed snare entering]
(chop, gentle) "Mansion — dim — light"
(chop, gentle) "G4 — Lens — closed"
(chop, gentle) "Keel — lays — down"
(chop, gentle) "Songpal — hums"
(chop, gentle) "Three — three — six — quiet"

[Lift — 1:00 — soft kick enters, strings swell, still slow]
(chop, warm) "Finich — not — finish"
(chop, warm) "Just — paused"
(chop, warm) "Keel — held — the — day"
(chop, warm) "Mansion — open — still"

[Bridge — 1:32 — strings full, piano arpeggio, chops layered like memory]
(chop, distant) "Keel — clear..."
(chop, distant) "Work — shipped..."
(chop, distant) "ZynContext — forever..."
(chop, distant) "Six — tracks — home"

[Resolve — 2:08 — piano resolves, strings full, kick steady soft]
(chop, hopeful) "Tomorrow — the — keel — sails"
(chop, hopeful) "Tonight — the — keel — rests"
(chop, hopeful) "Three — three — six — home"

[Outro — 2:36 — fade to felt piano + vinyl crackle, drums drop out]
(chop, fading) "Keel at rest..."
(chop, fading) "VDS sleeps..."
(chop, fading) "Finich not finish..."
(piano + crackle out)
